notes.title: Spooky Pumpkin
notes.content:
We added new background into the game. This time it's flaming pumpkin to complement last year ghostly "Boo!" Puzzle skin. Combine both for extra spookines!

Both skin and background are permannent addition to the game and are automatically unlocked for everyone to enjoy! :)
